prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction sticker of a chubby baby giraffe caught mid-cackle. Show it from the belly up, facing the viewer, with its head thrown back and its tiny front hooves curled beside its round belly. Give it a golden-yellow coat with warm brown patches, a gently curved giraffe neck, two little knob-tipped horns, and ears sticking out to the sides. Exaggerate the laugh until the face looks almost frog-like. The cheeks bunch up under two tiny squinting eyes, and the mouth gapes from cheek to cheek, taking up most of the face. Show a curved strip of white upper teeth, a deep burgundy mouth interior, and a big pink tongue at the bottom. Use smooth, softly shaded 3D cartoon forms, a tight centered crop, and a plain white background. Keep the sticker text-free.
